FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 260
Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs Sponsor: Representative Parker Moore
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/14/2025
House Bill 260 as introduced would increase membership on the Alabama Job Creation and
Military Stability Commission by two additional members, which would increase the
obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated $550 per meeting to reimburse the two
additional legislative members for legislative compensation, per diem and travel expenses for
attending meetings of the Commission, when the Legislature is not session.
